join.link-incomplete-body: Ask whoever sent it for the full link.
join.not-recognised-title: We do not recognise that invitation
join.not-recognised-body: The link may have been mistyped, or the group may have been deleted.
join.fresh-link-body: Ask whoever sent it for a fresh link — they can create one in seconds.
join.try-again-moment: Try the link again in a moment.
join.check-connection: Check your connection and try the link again.
join.heading: Join {name}
join.invited-campaign: You have been invited to observe with this campaign for the {contest} race.
join.invited-campaign-scope: You have been invited to observe with this campaign for the {contest} race in {scope}.
join.invited-cso: You have been invited to observe with this observer group for the {contest} race.
join.invited-cso-scope: You have been invited to observe with this observer group for the {contest} race in {scope}.
join.can-now-see: {name} can now see the reports you file from here on.
join.saved-unit: They have your saved polling unit ({pu}) as a starting point, and may confirm or change it.
my-groups.none:
You have not joined any campaign or observer group.
You do not need one — you can report on your own, exactly as you do now.
my-groups.lede: These groups can see the reports you have filed since you joined them. They cannot see anything the public cannot, and they cannot change how your reports are checked or counted.
my-groups.note: Being in a group never limits where you can report from. If you are sent somewhere else on the day, report from where you actually are — that report still counts, and your group will see where it came from.
my-groups.you-own: You own this group — open the situation room above.
my-groups.you-coordinate: You coordinate an area of this group — open the situation room above.
my-groups.you-manage: You manage this group — open the situation room above.
my-groups.unit-assigned: Unit they have you down for
my-groups.no-unit: They have not given you a polling unit.
my-groups.declined-note: You told them this is not where you will be. They can suggest another one.
my-groups.not-where: That is not where I will be
my-groups.send-failed: Could not send that just now.
my-groups.leave-confirm: Leave {name}? They will stop seeing which reports are yours. You will need a fresh invite to rejoin.
my-groups.load-failed: Could not load your groups. Check your connection and try again.
